title: Yellow Sauteed Jamaican Vermicelli Pasta
description: A dense and flavorful Jamaican dish featuring vermicelli pasta, perfect for meal prep. This low-carb-friendly recipe is a great option for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the vermicelli pasta according to package instructions.
In a large skillet, heat the coconut oil over medium heat.
Add the diced onion and minced garlic to the skillet and saute until the onion is translucent.
Add the scotch bonnet pepper to the skillet and saute for an additional minute.
Add the curry powder and thyme to the skillet and stir to combine.
Add the cooked vermicelli pasta to the skillet and stir to combine with the spice mixture.
Add the cooked chicken breast to the skillet and stir to combine with the pasta and spice mixture.
Season the pasta with salt to taste.
Serve the yellow sauteed Jamaican vermicelli pasta hot and enjoy.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
